testcase.name: Scenario: Select and exit constrained orbit: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/current-viewport-orbit-source/features/application/viewport-orbit/viewport-orbit.feature:20:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Select and exit constrained orbit ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its rectangular solid visible in the active part in the MCAD Software ✔ When the user opens the orbit menu on the navigation bar ✔ Then the menu offers Orbit, Constrained Orbit and Rotate at Angle ✔ When the user chooses Constrained Orbit ✔ Then a circular rotation guide appears over the viewport ✔ And the active part remains visible ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the guide disappears ✔ And the status area displays Ready ✔ When the user reopens the orbit menu ✔ Then Constrained Orbit is marked as the selected action
